title: Correction Remediation Knowledge Source Model
principle: Knowledge repairs need an auditable source and collection model before any backend-only knowledge mutation can be safe.
public_repo_rule: GitHub Pages may request model previews and record metadata-only decisions. It never receives document text, mutates knowledge sources or starts paid routes.

backend_route.purpose: Preview and record metadata-only knowledge source review and split models before any knowledge mutation execution.

ui_contract.auto_preview: commitRemediationAdapter automatically calls previewKnowledgeSourceModel when the backend returns a knowledge commit receipt

blocked_execution.reason: D242 records the source model only. D243 adds the dedicated backend-only execution gate; rollback remains the next protected slice.

scenarios.expected: A recorded knowledge commit automatically requests a knowledge source model preview.
Owners can record a metadata-only source model after preview confirmation.
Knowledge mutation remains blocked even after the source model is recorded.
Source model receipts expose public-safe metadata only and never document text.

next.label: Knowledge remediation rollback gates
next.reason: Knowledge source models and execution gates now exist. The next slice should add rollback gates for safe metadata restoration.
